messages:
Marie: Quick heads-up — Equinox Models proposed a combined cloud marketplace listing + HW bundle (SI integration included). We need licensing clarity, export classification, and a firm embargo for the joint announcement. Draft checklist below.
Alex: On it. Primary legal concerns: redistribution rights for quantized weights, sublicensing for SI, and any attribution/credit language.
Devin: For product — we need SKU mapping, model variant pinning, and a compatibility matrix for their SI installers. Also want to confirm which runtime optimizations are allowed.
Samir: Engineering note: if they want optimized kernels we need signed agreement on distributing quantized artifacts. Otherwise we serve from our model catalog and only expose model IDs.
Ola: Sales/GTm — timeline pls. Partner wants an end-of-quarter announcement. We should coordinate marketplace listing date + press coms.
Marie: Checklist (quick):
```
- Confirm license grant: commercial redistribution + sublicensing?
- Export classification (EAR/ECCN) + country restrictions
- Attribution text & trademark usage rules
- Where weights are hosted (Redwood vs partner)
- Quantized weights: allowed distribution? hosted-only?
- SI deliverables: installer packages, docs, runbook
- SKU mapping: HW bundles + marketplace SKU strings
- Announcement embargo date and embargo holder
```
Alex: Legal action items: I will escalate to IP export counsel for EAR classification and draft a simple addendum covering redistribution + attribution. Need a copy of Equinox's model license and manifest.
Devin: Can someone ask Equinox for: (1) exact license text, (2) model salt/hash, (3) test prompts they care about for quality gating?
Marie: @Ola can you request that from their bizdev? Also ask for a short blurb for marketplace description (50–80 words) and one quote for press.
Ola: Yep — I’ll get that today. Tentative embargo they proposed: 2025-05-12. Can we target marketplace live: 2025-05-13 (next day) if legal clears? :eyes:
Samir: Ops warning — if we switch to a hosted quantized artifact distribution we need to add hosting-region constraints to S3 buckets and add detection in infra for download allowances. That adds ~2 weeks.
Alex: If hosting adds time, we can do a phased approach: (A) list model on marketplace linking to our hosted runtime (no distributed weights), (B) later add HW bundle SKU with downloadable quantized weights after addendum signed.
Devin: That phased approach works. For SI integration we should publish an integration manifest and a validated-configuration artifact. I can draft the manifest template.
Marie: Ok agreed. Who owns the announcement calendar update? We need to put a firm embargo owner and an internal reviewer list.
Ola: I’ll own the calendar and coordinate press. Please add Legal (Alex), Product (Devin), Eng (Samir), Partnerships (Marie).
announce-bot: Reminder: add embargo to announcements board at /announce-calendar by EOD.
Alex: Next steps from legal: Equinox sends license + manifest, I return a one-page addendum and an export check estimate by Tue.
Devin: I’ll draft SKU mapping and manifest template by tomorrow and post to the thread.
Samir: I’ll scope infra changes for hosted quantized distribution and post an ETA (likely 10 business days if we need region isolation).
Marie: Great — thanks all. Ola, loop in their BD and ask for the blurb + license copy. Keep this thread for updates.
Ola: Will do. Adding the internal timeline to the thread in a bit. :shipit:
